title: Junior Software Engineer - AI Agents
description:
Relay AI is building software that lets companies create and run AI workers for operational tasks across sales, support, finance, research and internal operations.

We’re looking for an early-career Software Engineer to join a small product team and help build the systems behind those AI workers.

This is not a role where you’ll spend your first six months fixing tiny tickets. You’ll work directly on the product, ship features used by customers, and get exposure to both frontend and backend engineering.

What you’ll work on

You’ll help build features such as:

* Interfaces for creating, configuring and monitoring AI workers
* Backend APIs for running agent tasks and storing execution state
* Integrations with tools such as Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, Notion and Google Drive
* Human approval flows for actions that should not run autonomously
* Agent activity timelines, logs and debugging tools
* Permissions and access controls for customer data
* Background jobs for long-running AI tasks
* Internal tooling that helps us test and evaluate agent behaviour

You’ll also help investigate failures when an agent behaves unexpectedly and improve the systems that make those failures easier to understand.

Our stack

You do not need experience with everything below, but you should be comfortable learning quickly.

* TypeScript
* React / Next.js
* Node.js
* PostgreSQL
* REST APIs
* Cloud infrastructure
* LLM APIs and tool calling

What we’re looking for

You might be a good fit if you:

* Have built software outside of tutorials or university coursework
* Are comfortable writing TypeScript, JavaScript, Python or a similar language
* Understand basic web concepts such as APIs, databases and authentication
* Enjoy debugging and figuring out why systems behave the way they do
* Can take a loosely defined problem and turn it into something working
* Care about shipping useful software rather than only writing technically elegant code
* Want to work closely with founders and take ownership early

We care much more about evidence that you can build things than where you studied or whether you have worked at a well-known company.

Personal projects, open-source contributions, internships, hackathons and startup experience all count.

What you’ll get

You’ll join at an early stage and work directly with the founding team.

You’ll get:

* Real ownership over production features
* Exposure to AI agent infrastructure and applied LLM systems
* Frequent feedback and code reviews from experienced engineers
* A broad view across product, engineering and customer problems
* The opportunity to grow quickly as the engineering team expands

Interview process

We keep the process lightweight:

* Intro call
* Short practical coding exercise
* Technical discussion about your solution and projects
* Final conversation with the founders

We are not looking for LeetCode specialists. We are looking for people who can reason clearly, write solid software and learn quickly.

Pay: £45,000.00-£60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension
* UK visa sponsorship
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
### **Description**

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to take a hands-on role designing, building and shipping the services behind our growing rewards platform. Alongside writing great code, you’ll help raise the bar for those around you – sharing what you know, mentoring others and playing an increasingly influential role in how the team works.

  

### **What you’ll be getting stuck into**

  

* Design, build, test and ship high-quality services, working predominantly with Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript and React.
* Bring a T-shaped mindset, taking on the most important work to move Virgin Red towards its goals.
* Take ownership of meaningful pieces of work from the first design conversations right through to production – not simply completing tickets, but helping shape the best solution.
* Work across scalable, cloud-based systems, tackling the things that matter behind the scenes including performance, resilience, security and data.
* Be a senior technical voice in the team, reviewing code, pairing with others and mentoring more junior engineers to help everyone do their best work.
* Help turn loosely defined problems into clear, practical plans, breaking bigger pieces of work into manageable steps and keeping delivery moving.
* Bring energy, ideas and a willingness to speak up. You’ll be an important role model within the team, with plenty of opportunity to grow your leadership influence.
* Explore spec-driven development and AI-assisted engineering as our ways of working evolve, using new tools thoughtfully without compromising strong engineering fundamentals or quality.

  

### **What you’ll bring**

  

* Strong software engineering experience, particularly with Java, Spring, TypeScript and React, plus a solid understanding of what great software engineering looks like.
* Experience building and running scalable services in AWS, ideally including distributed systems, microservices, APIs and event-driven architecture.
* Confidence designing solutions as well as writing the code, with experience taking work from an initial problem through to something reliable in production.
* Commercial software engineering experience would be useful. Previous experience at Senior Engineer level is a bonus, but we’re much more interested in what you can do than the title you’ve had.
* The ability and willingness to support other engineers through mentoring, feedback, code reviews and sharing your knowledge.
* A positive, curious approach. You’ll bring some energy to the room, enjoy learning new things and be open to evolving how you work – including exploring tools such as AI-assisted development where they genuinely make engineering better.

  

### **What you’ll get in return**

We know life doesn’t stop when work starts. So we’ve built our benefits to support you - at work and beyond.

* **Life** – support when it matters most, with healthcare from day one, family-friendly policies and help for life’s bigger moments
* **Work** – the foundations that set you up for the future, including a competitive pension, life assurance and options like our EV scheme
* **Spirit** – space to grow and enjoy the journey, with a personal learning budget, mentoring, volunteering time… and our famous “Screw it, let’s do it” pot

It’s all designed to help you feel your best, do your best, and enjoy the ride - with a few extra Virgin touches along the way (because we don’t really do “standard”).  
  
**The essentials**

* **Salary**: £78,000 - £95,000 + bonus — we’re big on transparency, so no smoke and mirrors here. We’ll always offer a salary that reflects your experience, with room to grow within the range.
* **Where you’ll work:** We come together in our London office once a month, with flexibility to work from your own space the rest of the time. Ideally, you’ll be based in or near London so you can make the most of our office and opportunities to connect in person.

**Bring your whole self**

We welcome people from all walks of life, with all kinds of experiences and ways of thinking. Different perspectives, however your mind works, help us see things differently and do things better.

If there’s anything we can do to support you through the hiring process, just let us know, we’ll always do our best to make it work for you.

We believe in using business as a force for good, creating positive change for our people, our communities and the world around us. That includes being a Fair Chance employer and championing strengths like dyslexic thinking - staying open, listening to individual circumstances and focusing on potential.

**Where could this role take you? Your Virgin adventure starts here.**

### **About Virgin Red**

Virgin Red is the rewards club from Virgin*,* bringing together our world of brands, partners and experiences in one place.  
  
We make it easy for people to earn and spend Virgin Points on everything from everyday treats to once-in-a-lifetime moments. But it’s not just about rewards *-* it’s about creating a deeper connection to the Virgin experience and making every interaction feel a little more special.  
  
As part of the wider Virgin family, we think big but work hands-on. It’s fast-moving, collaborative, and full of opportunities to try new things and make your mark.  
  
**Watch our short "Who We Are" video** to discover how Virgin Group brings together over 40 businesses across the world, and how our small team helps shape the brand behind them all.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Ruby on Rails
description:
About Us

At Imagine Learning UK, our mission is to inspire aha! moments in students around the world, giving them the skills and knowledge they need to understand how their world works.

Previously known as Twig Education, our 2021 acquisition by Imagine Learning, the largest US digital curriculum provider, allows us to invest more in our products and support educators in transforming the learning experience for young people with our innovative digital resources.

In our new chapter, we continue to provide comprehensive and engaging multimedia learning experiences for students across a range of disciplines, including science, mathematics, English language, arts… and more! While our products have reached far and wide, we haven’t stopped growing – and we can’t wait to welcome more talented and passionate people into our team.

Our office is in the heart of Glasgow’s bustling West End located near parks, cafes and restaurants. Become part of a team where your contributions are valued, and where you can cuddle our friendly office dogs (you can meet them here!).

Sounds good, right? Take a sneak peek at just some of the work we do by watching this video.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on one of our Ruby on Rails teams, you solve real problems and ship features that are secure, well tested, and built to last. You’ll be fluent in Rails conventions and comfortable taking ownership of part of the system end to end, from data model through to deployment.

AI-assisted development is a natural part of how we build software here, and you’ll use agentic coding tools as part of your workflow, applying your judgement on when they can help and when a more considered approach is needed. You’ll also be comfortable using logs and metrics to understand and troubleshoot issues and deploying independently through our CI/CD pipeline.

You’ll be curious and keen to keep learning, sharing new ideas and insights with the wider team along the way.

Essential Job Functions

* Analyse requirements with Product Owners and translate them into practical solution designs, including realistic timelines and delivery expectations.

* Write Ruby on Rails code that follows established team conventions, with a focus on clarity, maintainability, and long-term quality.

* Use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot) as a normal part of daily development, and review and validate generated code with the same rigour applied to hand-written code.

* Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of the team’s AI tools, helping ensure coding agents produce output that aligns with team standards and practices.

* Write RSpec tests that provide confidence in application behaviours and help identify unintended impacts of changes before they reach production.

* Use metrics and observability data to identify opportunities for improvement and help strengthen logging and metrics where needed.

* Work confidently with data and databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar technologies, covering areas such as schema design, migrations and query performance.

* Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, responding to customer-impacting issues and working to resolve them in a way that maintains a positive customer experience.

* Take ownership of packaging and releasing your work through the CI/CD pipelines, helping to identify and resolve issues that may prevent a successful deploy.

* Contribute to pull request reviews, helping maintain and improve code quality in line with the team’s risk-based review approach.

* Create clear documentation that captures the thinking and reasoning behind technical decisions, helping current and future team members understand the context behind the work.

* Support and mentor other engineers, sharing knowledge across Ruby and Rails, and the effective and responsible use of AI development tools.

* Proactively identify areas of the application that could benefit from attention or improvement, and work with the Product Owner to help prioritise work.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (desirable but not essential)

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 3 years working in Ruby on Rails

Technical Skills

* Strong command of Ruby on Rails, including ActiveRecord, service objects, and background jobs (Sidekiq or similar).

* Comfortable designing and testing Rails applications using RSpec and FactoryBot, or an equivalent testing stack.

* Able to work independently on business problems, using sound judgement and seeking guidance when needed.

* Good understanding of AWS and how services are deployed and scaled, even where infrastructure is managed by others.

* Practical, hands-on experience with AI coding assistants, with an understanding of how to prompt effectively, review generated output critically and apply appropriate judgement to AI-assisted development.

* Comfortable reviewing AI-generated code and pull requests with the same care and attention as human-authored code, including considering security, performance and Rails best practice.

* Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).

* Takes a proactive approach to quality, including adding appropriate tests, logging and observability to their work.

* Able to create clear, concise documentation that helps others understand and work with the codebase.

* Some experience with JavaScript, Python, or Terraform would be useful but is not required for.

Competencies

* Able to support and mentor other Software Engineers, including junior team members and those developing their experience with AI-assisted workflows.

* Builds trust and influences others by using facts, evidence, and thoughtful reasoning to support recommendations and decisions.

* Communicates effectively with Product Owners, engineers and stakeholders at different levels across the organisation.

* Approaches disagreement and challenging conversations calmly and constructively.

* Champions team best practices across areas such as testing, documentation and AI coding conventions, while looking for ways to make delivery more effective.

* Comfortable working with ambiguity and adapting as AI tooling, development practices and tea needs continue to evolve.

What can we do for you?

We know what our staff are looking for when it comes to workplace perks. At Imagine Learning UK, you can enjoy benefits such as having flexible hybrid working options, a relaxed culture where hard work is recognised, plus a generous holiday allowance (to name just a few!)

Take a look at what else is in it for you:

* Get moving with the Cycle to Work scheme

* Enjoy discounts on shopping, travel and fitness

* Receive cashback on dental and optical with our Health Shield Cash Plan

* A pension scheme with salary sacrifice available, helping you save on National Insurance Contributions

Do you think we’re the right fit for you?

If you’re interested in a role that offers fulfilment and diversity, then please complete the Online Application Form, attaching a CV and cover letter that demonstrates the extent to which your skills, abilities and experience meet the requirements of this role.

Please note, applications which do not include both a CV and Covering Letter will not be considered.

Equal opportunities statement

Imagine Learning is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
